description: A 3HP crossfader between two signals, with a VCA input and a phase switch on the second one

params.text: Crossfades between the two inputs, input a alone at one end of its travel and input b alone at the other
A switch that flips the sign of input b before the crossfade, reading Normal in one position and Inverted in the other

inputs.text: A voltage of -5V to +5V here takes over from the a<->b knob, -5V giving input a alone and +5V input b alone
The voltage here divided by 10 multiplies the mixed signal, so 10V passes it at full level and 0V silences it
One of the two signals crossfaded
The other of the two signals crossfaded

outputs.text: The crossfade of the two inputs; with nothing patched to input a it carries a steady voltage instead, -5V to +5V across the travel of the a<->b knob
